Context: 5. Missing employees

Head of Office where the employee had last served. those who disappear after committing frauds/ FIR or Daily Diary Entry, whichever is the latest and obtain a report.  
1. Benefits payable in the first instance.Salary due, leave encashment due and the amount of GPF as per nominations made by the employee, on filing of a police report and submission of an indemnity bond.
